title: Measure, plan, light and calculate curtain fabric

say: Measure, plan, light, and calculate curtain fabric.
This is the video for module two of Interior Decoration Basics: measure, plan, light and dress the room.
Most expensive decorating mistakes are measuring mistakes. A sofa that will not pass through the door. Curtains 20 cm too short.

say: You need a 5 m or 8 m steel tape, graph paper and a pencil. Stand in the doorway and draw a rough outline. Mark the door, windows, sockets and anything fixed.

panel.heading: Measure and draw at 1:50
items: Sketch the room from the doorway
Measure each wall clockwise, in cm
Windows, doors, door swing, sockets
Check opposite walls match
Divide by 50: 2 cm on paper = 1 m

say: Start at one corner and work clockwise. Measure each wall along the floor, in centimetres.

panel.heading: Measure and draw at 1:50
items: Sketch the room from the doorway

Windows, doors, door swing, sockets
Check opposite walls match
Divide by 50: 2 cm on paper = 1 m

say: Measure each window and door, and draw the curve of the door swing. Furniture cannot sit inside that curve.

say: Opposite walls should be nearly the same. If one is 360 cm and the opposite is 342, measure both again.

say: Now draw at a scale of 1:50. Divide every measurement in centimetres by 50. Chiamaka's bedroom of 420 by 360 cm becomes 8.4 by 7.2 cm on paper.

say: Cut out furniture at the same scale and slide it around. Keep main walkways about 90 cm, and never block doors, sockets or windows.

panel.rule: Test layouts with paper cut-outs before moving heavy furniture.

say: Professionals plan light in layers. Ambient light fills the room so people can move safely.

panel.heading: Three layers of light
items: Ambient: general light to move safely
Task: focused light for reading, cooking
Accent: lamps and strips for mood
Compare lumens, not watts
Warm white for living rooms, bedrooms

say: Task light is brighter, for a job: a reading lamp, a desk lamp for homework, a light over the kitchen counter.

say: Accent light creates mood: a small table lamp, or a strip light behind the TV. One lamp in a dark corner often does more than a brighter ceiling bulb.

say: With LED bulbs, compare lumens. About 800 lumens gives roughly the light of an old 60 W bulb, using far less power, which matters on an inverter or generator.

say: Warm white, about 2700 to 3000 K, suits living rooms and bedrooms. For power cuts, put one light on the inverter circuit or use rechargeable lamps.

say: Aisha's client has a 1.8 m track, 2.4 m above the floor, for floor-length pencil pleat curtains. First, the cut drop: the finished drop plus about 30 cm for heading and hem. 2.4 plus 0.3 is 2.7 m.

panel.heading: Aisha's curtain fabric
items: Cut drop: 2.4 m + 0.3 m = 2.7 m
Across: 1.8 m track × 2 fullness = 3.6 m
Widths: 3.6 ÷ 1.4 = 2.57, round up to 3
Total: 3 widths × 2.7 m = 8.1 m

say: Pencil pleat curtains need about twice the track width, so 1.8 times 2 is 3.6 m of fabric across.

panel.heading: Aisha's curtain fabric
items: Cut drop: 2.4 m + 0.3 m = 2.7 m

say: The fabric is 1.4 m wide. 3.6 divided by 1.4 is 2.57, so round up to 3 widths.

panel.heading: Aisha's curtain fabric
items: Cut drop: 2.4 m + 0.3 m = 2.7 m

say: 3 widths times 2.7 m is 8.1 m. Patterned fabric needs more, because each drop is rounded up to whole pattern repeats. Tell the client before they choose.

panel.rule: Always round widths UP. Fabric is cut in full widths.

say: Now the cost. These prices are only for illustration. Check current prices at your market.
If the fabric sells for about 4,000 naira per metre,
then 8.1 m is about 32,400 naira, before lining, tape and tailoring. Many people round up to 8.5 m, in case of shrinkage or a cutting mistake.
When measuring high up, use a stable step ladder on a flat floor, never a plastic chair. Have someone hold it, and switch off ceiling fans.

cards.d: Use a stable step ladder, never a plastic chair. Someone holds it. Switch off ceiling fans.
Never wire it yourself. Use a qualified electrician. No cables under rugs.
Keep curtains away from cookers, candles, mosquito coils and hot bulbs.

say: Never do wiring yourself. Use a qualified electrician for new points and inverter connections. Do not overload sockets, and do not run cables under rugs.

say: Keep curtains and throws away from cookers, candles, mosquito coils and hot bulbs, and keep blind cords out of children's reach.

say: To remember. Measure clockwise in centimetres and draw at 1:50. Keep walkways about 90 cm. Plan ambient, task and accent light. Widths equal track times fullness, divided by fabric width. Always round up, and allow more for patterns.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Measure clockwise in cm; draw at 1:50
Walkways about 90 cm; doors stay clear
Ambient, task and accent light
Widths = track × fullness ÷ fabric width
Round widths up; patterns need more

say: Now practise. Draw one room to scale and try two layouts with cut-outs. Map the light in a room and mark where a task and an accent light should go. And calculate curtains for a real window, plain and patterned.
